visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a low-angle shot of the modern exterior of the OPTIMA WELLNESS MUSEUM (OWM) in Gangnam, featuring a large banner with Korean text. (2) The scene transitions to the interior, showcasing bright, minimalist wooden shelving units filled with various wellness products under warm, recessed lighting. (3) A close-up follows, showing informational signs for "FAMILY GIFT SET" and "Curation Theme Zone A" with vibrant illustrations. (4) The main female character, with long black hair and wearing a black top, sits at a wooden table across from a pharmacist in professional attire and a face mask; they are discussing health products. (5) The two women move to a "Biogram" health monitoring station where the creator stands on a scale while the pharmacist operates the digital interface in a clean, clinical setting. (6) A close-up shows the creator smiling and holding her smartphone, followed by a product display shelf featuring white tubes of "BADECASIL P" cream by the brand "23YEARSOLD". (7) The creator's hand holds a clear concealer tube close to the camera, emphasizing the brand name. (8) A wide shot displays the "Pharmacy Derma Skin Care" shelf, densely packed with skincare and cosmetics. (9) The creator holds two concealer tubes near her face, wearing a black headband with ears, and then applies the product to red spots on her forehead and cheek with a wand. (10) She uses a black cushion puff to blend the concealer into her skin, looking into the camera. (11) A split-screen comparison shows the skin before and after concealer application, followed by swatches of four shades (2N, 1Y, 1.5B, 0.5P) on her arm. (12) The creator is seen walking through the spacious pharmacy aisles with a shopping basket, then holds up a round white product labeled "BREATH". (13) The final shot pans across the organized skincare shelves of the pharmacy.

(18) [Slogan]: 來韓國玩 記得把O.W.M藥局 納入你的旅遊地點清單. (19) [Slogan]: 來了更是不要錯過 23YEARSOLD的產品 偷偷說 痘痘藥膏也很好用!!

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with an upbeat, acoustic pop background track featuring strummed guitar and a steady percussion beat. A female narrator speaks in Mandarin with a cheerful, clear voice, introducing a visit to a pharmacy. (2) As the video displays the interior, the narration remains continuous and energetic, with a low ambient room tone underneath. (3) A subtle digital 'pop' sound effect occurs as a graphic transition appears on screen. (4) A soft mechanical whirring sound is briefly audible as the narrator mentions body metrics testing. (5) The narrator's pitch rises slightly with excitement as she shifts the topic to skincare and makeup brands. (6) A faint plastic rustling sound is heard when products are handled. (7) The background music maintains its consistent tempo as the narrator gives detailed product recommendations. (8) The audio ends with a bright final guitar strum and the narrator's concluding cheerful remark.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator specifically visits the pharmacy to find the '23YEARSOLD' brand, demonstrates the product on her face, shows shade swatches, and provides a direct recommendation to viewers.
